title: Conjugate of anti-igf-1r antibody with drug and use thereof for treating cancer
abstract: FIELD: chemistry; medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to biochemistry, particularly to an antibody conjugate with a drug for treating IGF-lR-expressing cancer, as well as to a composition for treating IGF-1R-expressing cancer containing an effective amount of at least one of said drug-drug conjugate. Also disclosed is a method of treating IGF-1R-expressing cancer in a subject in need thereof, comprising using said conjugate.EFFECT: invention enables effective treatment of IGF-lR-expressing cancer.22 cl, 29 dwg, 16 tbl, 21 ex
